# AI4Kanban

> AI4Kanban is an open-source, local-first kanban board for AI agents. It prepares the
> key drafts for each task — a UI mockup, a copy draft, a storyboard, figures — so you
> settle the direction first, then specialist agents finish the rest within the agreed
> scope. It covers product development and content creation, and connects to 8 tools
> such as Claude Code and Codex, running on your machine with your own subscriptions.

Each page below has a plain-Markdown mirror (the `.md` links) with the full page
content — no navigation, styling, or scripts.

## Pages

- [Home — See the draft. Let agents do the rest.](https://ai4kanban.dev/index.md): AI4Kanban prepares key drafts for tasks on your board. You review what matters, agents handle the details, and you move more work forward on your own.
- [Builder — why Tao Wu is building AI4Kanban](https://ai4kanban.dev/builder.md): How Tao Wu went from trying to let agents plan a project on their own, through early users' feedback that it didn't feel faster, to having people confirm key drafts before agents build the rest.
- [Kanban for Claude Code](https://ai4kanban.dev/agents/kanban-for-claude-code): An agent workspace for indie hackers. Review key drafts before Claude Code builds, use Codex for writing alongside Claude Code for coding, and carry project preferences into later tasks. Follow-up suggestions and scheduled QA help find what to improve next.
- [Kanban for Codex](https://ai4kanban.dev/agents/kanban-for-codex): Manage tasks above individual Codex conversations. Specialist workflows identify what needs your judgment and present UI prototypes, prompt diffs, copy and other drafts before execution. Use development and marketing workflows, choose runtimes per agent, and carry role-specific preferences into later tasks. Codex keeps using your installed skills.
- [Kanban for Grill Me](https://ai4kanban.dev/agents/kanban-for-grill-me): Split a complex idea into bounded cards in one session, then plan each card in its own session. Closely related cards can form a group task whose parent supplies shared context; unrelated tasks can stay standalone. Relevant project decisions guide all cards, and dependencies take precedence over priority. Drafts specify the parts agents must follow exactly.
- [AI4Kanban for coding](https://ai4kanban.dev/workflows/coding.md): Review key interface, prompt, copy and email drafts on the task card before implementation. Agents build from the approved drafts and plan. Includes independent desktop and phone previews, product questions, agent memory, follow-up suggestions, and a small October 2026 cost test.
- [AI4Kanban for SaaS](https://ai4kanban.dev/solutions/saas.md): An agent workspace for SaaS founders and small teams to develop features and prepare marketing on one board. Review key drafts for coding, landing pages and newsletters. Blog posts, product videos, image-based slide decks and carousel posts require Pro. Independent tasks can run in parallel using project context and relevant preferences; new decisions still need your input.
- [draft-first — see the draft, then build](https://ai4kanban.dev/draft-first): An open-source skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and other coding agents that read `.claude/skills/` or `.agents/skills/`. Install with `npx draft-first install`. Before building, the agent drafts screens, prompts with sample outputs, copy and images; you delete, note and confirm them on a local review page, and the agent builds from what you confirmed. Drafts stay in `.draft-first/` in your project. Source: https://github.com/ai4kanban/draft-first
- [Download — AI4Kanban for macOS, Windows and Linux](https://ai4kanban.dev/download): Get the desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux — nothing to install first. Every file on the current release (Apple Silicon and Intel `.dmg`, the Windows `.exe`, the x64 and arm64 `.AppImage`), and what to click past each system's first-open warning while the builds are unsigned.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Taskmaster](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-task-master.md): Compare AI4Kanban and Taskmaster on specialist workflows, draft review, preference memory, and how tasks move from planning to execution.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Hermes Agent Kanban](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-hermes-kanban.md): Compare AI4Kanban and Hermes Kanban on specialist workflows, draft review, chat-app control, parallel tasks and follow-up work.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Multica](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-multica.md): Compare AI4Kanban and Multica on specialist agents, workflow setup, draft review, preference memory and team collaboration.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Orca](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-orca.md): Compare AI4Kanban and Orca on session control, specialist workflows, draft review and the work needed to coordinate execution.
- [AI4Kanban vs. Plannotator](https://ai4kanban.dev/vs-plannotator.md): Compare AI4Kanban and Plannotator on draft and code review, specialist workflows, parallel tasks and how work continues after approval.

## Documentation

Every documentation page carries a "Copy page" button that hands you its raw
Markdown, so these need no separate mirror.

- [Documentation overview](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs): How to run AI4Kanban, the kanban board for AI agents: install it, drive the daily loop, and pick the coding agent your work runs on.
- [Your first card](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/first-card): Follow an idea through planning, review the screen draft, request changes, then build and check the delivered work.
- [Draft review](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/drafts): See the final version of the parts you care about most, change it on the card, and approve what agents will build.
- [Memory](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/memory): How project memory, agent memory and global memory carry your preferences forward, and how they stay current without you.
- [Workflows](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/workflows): Use six built-in workflows for development and marketing, let AI4Kanban match your request to a workflow, or create your own.
- [The daily loop](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/daily-loop): The rhythm once the board exists: pick what to work on, add and refine cards, build one end to end, check what it leaves you, and finish it.
- [Chat](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/chat): Explore an idea, request draft changes or update a card in a conversation with your board's context.
- [Agents](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/agents): Every flow is run by a named agent. You give each one a rule, some of them remember, and where the board has a hook you add your own.
- [Runs and runtimes](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/runs): Monitor background work, recover a failed run and choose the coding tool and model each agent uses.
- [Triage](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/triage): Triage is a queue beside your cards for follow-ups, the Proposer's ideas and items your scripts add. What lands there is a lead, not a task: make a card of it, or ignore it.
- [Local and Cloud boards](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/local-and-cloud-boards): A Local board is Markdown in your repository. A Cloud board lives in a workspace we host, opens on every machine you sign in from, and reads in a browser. What each one is, and what moving between them costs.
- [Multi-runtime support](https://ai4kanban.dev/docs/connectors): Connect the coding tool you already use, choose a runtime and model for each agent, and set what a run may touch.

## More

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ai4kanban/ai4kanban): Source, user guides, and an example of AI4Kanban managing its own development.
